Pineapple Teriyaki Sauce
By: Matt
Published: Thursday, February 16, 2017 - 12:01am

Ingredients




3 cloves garlic (minced)
1 inch ginger (finely grated)
2 tablespoons olive oil
1⁄2 pineapple
1 tsp sesame oil
2 tsps sesame seeds (toasted)
1⁄2 cup soy sauce

Preparation

1 Cut the skin and eyes off the pineapple and the pineapple then into chunks, discarding the hard, white center. 2 Place the pineapple into a blender or food processor and blend until smooth. 3 In a bowl, mix all the ingredients together, including the pineapple and serve immediately.

About

homemade naturally sweet and thick pineapple teriyaki sauce
